_doc: Verdicts beside the Jev harvest sitting over Cañada College (typesafe-smoke.yml run 39197675380, 2026-10-19 04:07Z; artifact jev-harvest, harvest_ca_ada.json; 22 records failing a machine check, 22 asked, 0 errors). Each verdict is a SESSION's reading (S421 SkyTupelo) of the committed record's own score and the first reader's notes, which quote the page; the session did not read the catalog page itself, and Sam has not read these. 'agree' means the record's evidence supports Jev's cause; 'owner_differs' means the cause holds but the fix belongs elsewhere; 'unverified' means the record alone cannot settle it. No gate is set: kb/_jev_adjudicate.py GATES takes a measured precision of 1.00 on a person's verdicts, and these are a session's over 16 of 22.

reading: Jev's cause matched the record's own evidence on every one of the 16 rows the evidence settles (10 agree, 6 owner_differs where the cause holds and the owner is the college's procedure rather than the scorer or the extraction). The 6 unverified rows are the five careers-only failures and one unit figure, which need the page. Owner is where Jev leans wrong: it names the scorer for a figure a procedure step supplies, and the extraction for a page the reader cut. The five Cal-GETC rows are one fix: Cañada's wording of the Cal-GETC sentence, then a reconcile step as Taft's. S424 SkyBuckthorn, 2026-10-19: the five careers-only rows (16816, 32452, 32716, 32795, 41287) were never failing records. The scorer's careers check is reported beside the checks and holds no record back (careers_check: 'it holds no record back'; the scorer's pass leaves it out, as program_record_machine_pass does), and the sitting's failing() counted every check with pass false. failing() now reads the five checks that hold a record back, so the next sitting asks about 17 of Cañada's records, not 22; the five rows stand as recorded, their question (a paraphrase or a line break in the PDF) open and of no consequence to the gate.
